user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 609 lux 到 726 lux
IF 人不在家 THEN 清洁环境
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF LG_brightness_sensor.get_brightness() < 436 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_up() philips_zhiyi_light
IF LG_brightness_sensor.get_brightness() > 436 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_light_down() philips_zhiyi_light
IF qingping_air_monitor.reading_PM2_5() > 33 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN turn_on() mijia_air_purifier
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN start_sweep() viomi_vacuum
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN beep() LG_fire_detector
IF LG_fire_detector.is_fire() == true THEN open_door() Blade_Star_smart_door
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_light_off() philips_zhiyi_light
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() mijia_air_purifier
